title: Recording: Have You Seen My Baby by Ringo Starr | 1973
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

An overdub session for Ringo Starr’s third studio album, Ringo, was held on 15 May 1973.

It was for ‘Have You Seen My Baby’, the backing track of which had been recorded on 5 March. The song was completed on 11 July.
